subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@fintechcorp.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Alice / Raj,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed POC/evaluation plan to make it easy to align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. I attached a one-page plan (POC-Eval-Plan-FTCorp-v1.pdf) and a PS estimate spreadsheet.

Demo highlights
- We showed Redwood Inference serving flow: low-latency prompts, KV cache warmup, and the cost/latency dashboard.
- You liked the model routing idea (latency SLA + cost tier fallback) and the built-in trace links for failed requests.

Proposed POC / evaluation outline (high level)
1) Objective: Validate Redwood meets FinTechCorp latency and cost targets while preserving prompt quality for two key flows (Customer Support summarization, Pricing model inference).
2) Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
   - Latency: p95 < 180ms for the short-response flow under production-like load (50 rps).
   - Cost: token cost <= target threshold (we put a conservative estimate in the attached PS sheet).
   - Quality: automated eval against current answers must have <= 5% regression in F1/ROUGE on your test prompts; manual QA on a 100-sample set with product team signoff.
   - Reliability: 99.9% request success rate (errors vs accepted responses) during a 48h soak.
3) Scope and dataset:
   - You provide a 10k prompt sample + 200 example pairs for manual review. We can anonymize/pseudonymize if needed.
4) Timeline (proposed):
   - Week 0 (Kickoff): contract and security review start; drive access + sample data requested. — Target: Mar 15
   - Week 1: infra provisioning, model selection + baseline runs — Target: Mar 22
   - Week 2: run soak tests and automated evals — Target: Mar 29
   - Week 3: manual QA round + final review — Target: Apr 5
5) Ownership / touchpoints:
   - FinTechCorp: Alice (technical lead), Raj (product lead)
   - Redwood: Marissa (AE / program lead), Vivek (SRE / infra), Dylan (solutions engineer)
6) Next steps (please confirm):
   - Confirm success criteria above or propose edits.
   - Share sample dataset and security point of contact.
   - Confirm kickoff date (we suggested Mar 15).

Attachments: POC-Eval-Plan-FTCorp-v1.pdf (short plan), Redwood-PS-Estimate-FTCorp.xlsx

If this looks good I'll circulate a short SOW and security checklist to get procurement started.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199
[Attachment: POC-Eval-Plan-FTCorp-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Redwood-PS-Estimate-FTCorp.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechcorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and plan, this is exactly the level of detail we wanted. A few quick questions/notes from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Dataset: we can provide the 10k prompt sample but need to run it by Legal for redaction. Expect ~3 business days.
2) Latency target: p95 < 180ms sounds reasonable for the short flow; for the pricing model inference the p95 might be closer to 250ms given model size. Can we make the plan have tiered targets per flow?
3) Security: we need the SOC2 docs and an IP/data handling addendum before we share the sample. Can you send those?
4) Procurement: our procurement lead (cc’d) will need a short SOW + estimated cost to approve the PS spend.

We’re interested in starting the kickoff the week of Mar 22 if Legal/procurement timelines force a delay. Otherwise Mar 15 is fine.

I’ll confirm once Legal signs off on the dataset.

Best,
Alice
Alice Zhang
Head of Machine Learning, FinTechCorp
alice.zhang@fintechcorp.com
[Sent from mobile]

Vivek / Dylan,

Looping you both in on Alice’s notes. Action items: 
- Vivek: please pull the SOC 2 summary and our standard IP/data handling addendum; I’ll add them to the shared folder and send to Alice. Aim to have docs by EOD today.
- Dylan: please prepare a two-tier latency/cost target write-up: one set for the short-response flow (p95 < 180ms) and one for the pricing flow (p95 target ~250ms). Also prepare a quick note on model variant suggestions (quantized vs full) and expected token-cost delta.

I’m replying to Alice to propose flexible kickoff (Mar 15 or Mar 22) depending on Legal. I’ll also draft the short SOW and PS estimate to attach.

Thanks,
Marissa
